messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm planning to pin minotaur4b v2 to the staging slot tomorrow 11:00 PT. Quiet window reserved. Need smoke owner and rollback ready. :rocket:
samir: I can own the smoke run. What's the plan? latency SLOs?
maya: Thanks Samir. Smoke checklist: basic gen tests (prompt_set smoke_basic), 95p latency < 300ms, memory/oom check, sample-quality spot-check. Run can be the `staging-smoke` script.
ops-bot: slot reservation confirmed: staging-slot-12 reserved from 10:45-12:00 PT for minotaur4b:v2 by @maya.
jonathan: I'll watch infra and headroom. If we see 95p > 350ms we rollback. Who has the pin command?
prasad: use `redwood catalog pin minotaur4b:v2 --slot=staging-slot-12 --actor=maya` (run from control plane). Also add `--dry-run` first if you want.
samir: I'll run smoke at 11:10 and post results. quick ask: can we prewarm KV cache?
maya: yes, run `scripts/prewarm_kv.sh minotaur4b 500` after pin completes.
liz: Add me as approver for prod pin. For staging ok. Ping me if quality looks off. :eyes:
caroline: PR for model config: https://git.redwood/minotaur/configs/pull/42 — has tokenization fix and fallback variant. Please review when you can.
samir: smoke done: basic prompts passed (all outputs plausibly sensible). latency: median 120ms, 95p 280ms. No OOM. Attaching snippet:
```
PASS smoke_basic (N=20)
LAT median=0.120s 95p=0.280s
```
maya: awesome. Approve to proceed with canary tomorrow in prod window 02:00 PT unless we see issues. Rollback plan: revert pin with `redwood catalog unpin minotaur4b --slot=staging-slot-12 --actor=maya` and restore alias to v1.
jonathan: noted. I'll keep metrics dashboard ready and set an alert at 95p>350ms. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy note: deployment started by maya at 2790123456, status: staging pin complete.
liz: quick question — does this change require any SDK version bump? caroline?
caroline: no SDK changes. config-only. Good to go.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll close out postmortem checklist after the prod canary. Leaving thread open for final signoffs. :white_check_mark:
